places.name: Halal Birdz
places.about: Halal Birdz is a newer halal hot chicken concept on Murfreesboro Pike in South Nashville, serving Nashville-style hot chicken tenders, wings, and loaded snack packs at a counter-service spot.
places.ate: The #3 Broadway Box (medium heat) and the #4 Halal Snack Pack (medium heat).

Sam's order: the #3 Broadway Box and #4 Halal Snack Pack, medium heat, Halal Birdz

places.name: Maru WeHo
places.about: Maru is a Nashville-based sushi restaurant group with several locations across the city. This one sits in the Wedgewood-Houston (WeHo) neighborhood just south of downtown, in a sleek, industrial-style space with a full sushi bar, specialty rolls, and a cocktail menu.
places.ate: The Pink Lady, Tiger, and Dynamite rolls.

photos.alt: Maru WeHo storefront sign, Wedgewood-Houston, Nashville
Inside Maru WeHo, dining room and sushi bar
Sam's order: Pink Lady, Tiger, and Dynamite rolls, Maru WeHo

pros: Great date night or business meeting spot

places.name: Daddy's Dogs
places.about: Daddy's Dogs started as a Nashville street cart in 2015 before growing into several brick-and-mortar locations around the city. This location, in The Nations, is set inside a converted gas station painted bright yellow, with a covered patio, cornhole, and a menu built entirely around specialty hot dogs and hand-spun shakes.
places.ate: The Mac Daddy and the Big Daddy.

photos.alt: Ordering at the walk-up window, Daddy's Dogs, The Nations, Nashville
Covered patio and picnic tables at Daddy's Dogs, Nashville
Sam's order: the Mac Daddy and the Big Daddy hot dogs, Daddy's Dogs

places.name: Baam Burger
places.parking: Paid parking nearby, no free lot
places.about: Baam Burger is a smashed-burger concept tucked into The Arcade in downtown Nashville, just steps off Broadway. The counter-service spot serves smashed patties, fries, and hand-spun milkshakes, staying open late into the night as a go-to stop for people out on Broadway.
places.ate: Baam burger with no pickles, a side of fries, and a vanilla milkshake.

photos.alt: Baam Burger storefront sign, The Arcade, downtown Nashville
Sam's order: Baam burger with bacon and cheese, fries, and a vanilla milkshake

places.name: Ladybird Taco
places.about: Ladybird Taco brings a Texas-style breakfast taco stand to Nashville's 12 South neighborhood, calling itself "a little TX in TN." The counter-service spot serves a numbered menu of breakfast tacos alongside coffee and lunch options, in a bright, communal-table space that's become a popular morning stop in the neighborhood.

photos.alt: Ladybird Taco storefront mural, 12 South, Nashville
Inside Ladybird Taco, communal tables and counter
Sam's order: three foil-wrapped breakfast tacos, Ladybird Taco

cons: Could have to wait for a table, it was packed

places.name: Chen Chen's
places.about: Chen Chen's Nashville Hot Chicken started as a pop-up in Toronto in 2019 from chef Chen Chen, who was born in China and raised in Nashville. It grew into a permanent Toronto restaurant in 2021, went on to be named Yelp Canada's #1 Place to Eat in 2024, and has now brought the concept back to Chen's hometown, combining classic Nashville hot chicken with his own Asian-inspired flavors and sauces.
places.ate: Homemade Mac & Cheese with Hot Chicken Bites, Szechuan sauce, medium heat, and a side of waffle fries.

photos.alt: Chen Chen's Nashville Hot Chicken storefront, 130 19th Ave N, Nashville
Inside Chen Chen's Nashville, counter and seating area
Sam's order: Mac & Cheese with Szechuan hot chicken bites, Chen Chen's Nashville

places.name: NADC Burger
places.about: NADC, short for "Not A Damn Chance," is a single-item burger concept with a Nashville outpost tucked inside the historic Arcade downtown. True to its stripped-down format, there's just one burger on the menu: two smashed 3 oz patties of 100% Wagyu beef, American cheese, a tangy secret sauce, onions, pickles, and jalapeños on a griddled bun, backed up by a short drink list and a brown-butter chocolate chip cookie for dessert.
places.ate: NADC Burger with everything, a side of fries, and their secret sauce.

photos.alt: NADC Burger storefront inside The Arcade, downtown Nashville
Sam's order: the NADC Burger with everything and a side of fries
Close-up of the NADC Burger, cheese and pickled jalapenos

places.name: Prince St. Pizza
places.about: Prince St. Pizza traces back to 2012 in New York's Nolita neighborhood, built on recipes that have stayed in the Morano family for generations, their philosophy is simple: if it works on pasta, it works on pizza. The original NYC shop made its name on the Sicilian "SoHo Square," a thick, crispy-bottomed slice, and the Spicy Spring, its signature square topped with pepperoni cups, fresh mozzarella, and tomato sauce. The brand has since expanded well beyond New York, and this location, inside the Fifth + Broadway development in downtown Nashville, is its first in Tennessee.
places.quickTake: A solid, no-frills square slice with real New York pedigree, the Spicy Vodka and Naughty Pie both deliver plenty of flavor. It doesn't quite live up to the legendary hype of the original Nolita shop, but it's a dependable, affordable stop if you're downtown and want a genuinely good slice fast.
places.ate: The Spicy Vodka, The Naughty Pie, and the Houston Jalapeno, three square slices, three very different heat levels.

photos.alt: Prince St. Pizza storefront and patio seating, Fifth + Broadway, Nashville
Prince St. Pizza's display case with fresh square slices, Nashville
Sam's order: three square slices in the box, Prince St. Pizza Nashville
Sam holding a Prince St. Pizza box, home of the spicy pepperoni

cons: Not 100% fresh unless you order a whole pie
